documents.page_title: About IIT Patna Centre for Educational Technology (CET)
documents.summary: Mandate, mission, establishment in 2023 under NEP-2020 by IIT Patna Senate to disseminate quality, affordable, industry-aligned technology education.
documents.content:
The Centre for Educational Technology (CET) at the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) was created by the IIT Patna Senate to disseminate quality, affordable, and industry-demand-driven skill-based education in strict alignment with the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP-2020).
Commencing undergraduate programs in streams of Computer Science and Business Management in July 2023, CET operates as a dedicated technology-enabled academic entity.
The center offers innovative pedagogy and hybrid learning models to empower students and working professionals.
Institutional Address: IIT Patna Campus, Bihta, Patna - 801106, Bihar, India.
Contact Email: cet_office@iitp.ac.in.
Official Website: https://cet.iitp.ac.in/.

chunks.text: The Centre for Educational Technology (CET) was established by the IIT Patna Senate following the adoption of NEP-2020. The first step was marked by the commencement of undergraduate programs in Computer Science and Business Management in July 2023. CET aims to disseminate quality and industry-demand-driven education without barriers at an affordable cost.

documents.page_title: CET Academic Programs — Undergraduate, Postgraduate & Executive Degrees
documents.summary: Catalog of 9+ degree programs approved by IIT Patna Senate, including BS in AICS, BS in CSDA, BBA, BBA-MBA, MTech, and MBA with GenAI.
documents.content:
CET IIT Patna provides 9+ Senate-approved degree programs with modular pathways and flexible exit credentials compliant with NEP 2020:
1. BS in Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security (BS-AICS): 4-year degree focusing on deep learning, cryptography, defensive cybersecurity, and generative AI.
2. BS in Computer Science and Data Analytics (BS-CSDA): 4-year degree focusing on big data pipelines, statistical machine learning, distributed computing, and visual analytics.
3. Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA): 3-year program with management core.
4. Integrated BBA-MBA: 5-year fast-track management career program.
5. BS-MS Dual Degree in AICS / CSDA: 5-year integrated postgraduate pathway.
6. MS in AICS / CSDA: Master of Science for technology graduates seeking advanced specialization.
7. MBA: Master of Business Administration with industry-aligned curriculum.
8. MBA in Generative AI & Project Management (Gen AI & PM).
9. MTech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science Engineering (AI & DSE / CSE).
Intakes occur twice per year (Autumn and Spring sessions).

chunks.text: Undergraduate programs at CET IIT Patna include: (1) BS in Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security (AICS), (2) BS in Computer Science and Data Analytics (CSDA), and (3) Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA). The BS degrees are 4-year, 160-credit modular programs allowing certificate, diploma, and degree exits under NEP 2020.

documents.page_title: CET Admission Eligibility & Entrance Test Regulations
documents.summary: Mandatory eligibility criteria, minimum qualifying percentage (60%), approved national tests (JEE, CUET, NEET, BITSAT), international scores (SAT, BMAT), and IITP-SAT.
documents.content:
Official Admission Eligibility Regulations at IIT Patna CET:
1. BS in Artificial Intelligence & Cyber Security (AICS) / BS in Computer Science & Data Analytics (CSDA) / BS-MS:
   - Educational Qualification: 10+2 (Class XII) in Science stream with minimum 60% cumulative aggregate marks.
   - Entrance Criteria (any one of the following):
     (a) Valid score or rank in National/State Level Entrance: JEE (Main/Advanced), NEET, CUET, BITSAT, KVPY/NTSE/INSPIRE scholarship holders, or State Engineering Entrance Examinations.
     (b) Valid score in International Entrance Tests: US (SAT-I / SAT-II) or UK (BMAT).
     (c) IITP-SAT online entrance test conducted by IIT Patna CET followed by virtual interview.
   - Course Duration: 3 Years (B.Sc.), 4 Years (BS Honours), 5 Years (BS-MS) respectively with modular entry, exit, and re-entry options.

2. Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA):
   - Educational Qualification: 10+2 (any stream) with minimum 60% cumulative aggregate marks.
   - Entrance Criteria: Valid score in National/State level entrance (JEE/CUET/etc.), international SAT, or IITP-SAT followed by virtual interview.
   - Course Duration: 3 Years (Modular with entry, exit, and re-entry options).

3. Application Mode:
   - Official application portal: https://registrations.iitp-cep.in/.

chunks.text: For B.Sc. (Hons.) / B.S. / B.S-M.S. in CSDA and AICS: Eligibility requires 10+2 in Science with minimum 60% cumulative aggregate marks. Applicants must hold a valid score/rank in JEE (Main/Advanced), NEET, CUET, BITSAT, KVPY/NTSE/INSPIRE, State Entrance Examinations, US SAT-I/SAT-II, UK BMAT, OR clear the IITP-SAT entrance test followed by virtual interview.

chunks.text: For Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA): Eligibility requires 10+2 with minimum 60% cumulative aggregate. Duration is 3 years with modular entry, exit, and re-entry options under NEP-2020.

documents.page_title: CET Online Application Portal & Registration Procedures
documents.summary: Official web portal for submitting online application forms, document uploads, and tracking admission status for IIT Patna CET programs.
documents.content:
Official Online Registration Portal: https://registrations.iitp-cep.in/.
Candidates seeking admission to CET IIT Patna undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive degree programs must apply through the central registration portal.
Application Procedure:
1. Account creation using email and mobile verification.
2. Selection of target program (BS AICS, BS CSDA, BBA, BBA-MBA, MTech, etc.).
3. Upload of academic credentials (Class 10 mark sheet, Class 12 mark sheet, photo ID, entrance scorecard).
4. For candidates applying without JEE/CUET scores, selection of IITP-SAT test slot.
5. Online payment of application fee.
Advisory: The CET AI chatbot does NOT process admission applications or collect applicant payment details. All submissions must be performed directly at https://registrations.iitp-cep.in/.

chunks.text: The official admissions portal for IIT Patna CET is https://registrations.iitp-cep.in/. Prospective students must register online, upload academic transcripts (10th/12th mark sheets), provide qualifying entrance test details (or register for IITP-SAT), and complete verification directly on the portal.

documents.page_title: CET Academic Evaluation Scheme & Grading Regulations
documents.summary: Evaluation structure: continuous internal assessment (class tests 20%, assignments 30%), proctored end-sem (50%), 75% attendance rule, distinction threshold, and grading scale.
documents.content:
Official Evaluation Scheme at IIT Patna CET:
The evaluation scheme comprises learner-friendly continuous evaluation and hands-on practical training desirable by employers.
1. Weightage Distribution:
   - 20% - Class test, surprise quizzes
   - 30% - Regular assignments and laboratory demonstrations
   - 50% - End-semester examination (proctored)
   In theory/ordinance frameworks, continuous internal assessment accounts for 40% (Quizzes 15%, Mid-sem 20%, Classwork 5%) and End-Semester covers 50-60%.
2. Distinction Criteria:
   - A student obtaining marks >= 75% or an equivalent grade would be awarded degree with distinction.
3. Attendance Regulations:
   - Minimum 75% verified attendance in lectures and laboratory sessions is strictly required.
   - Students with attendance below 75% are awarded an 'XX' grade and debarred from the End-Semester Examination.
4. Grading System:
   - AP: 10 points (Exceptional / top 5%)
   - AA: 10 points (Outstanding)
   - AB: 9 points (Excellent)
   - BB: 8 points (Very Good)
   - BC: 7 points (Good)
   - CC: 6 points (Fair / Average)
   - CD: 5 points (Below Average)
   - DD: 4 points (Marginal Pass — minimum credit-earning grade)
   - F: 0 points (Fail — credit not earned, requires supplementary exam)
   - XX: 0 points (Debarred due to attendance shortage < 75%)
5. Remedial / Supplementary Examinations:
   - Capped at grade 'CC' (Grade Point 6) maximum.

chunks.text: The official CET evaluation scheme consists of: 20% class tests and surprise quizzes, 30% regular assignments and lab work, and 50% proctored end-semester examination. A student obtaining marks >= 75% or an equivalent grade is awarded their degree with distinction.

chunks.text: Attendance requirement: Minimum 75% verified attendance is strictly enforced. Attendance below 75% results in an 'XX' grade and debarment from end-semester exams. Letter grades range from AP/AA (10 points) down to DD (4 points, lowest pass). Grade F (0 points) requires re-examination, capped at CC grade.

documents.summary: Official semester windows: UG Autumn (August to December) and UG Spring (January to June), covering registration, mid-sem, quiz, and end-sem exam periods.
documents.content:
Official Academic Calendars at IIT Patna CET:
The academic year is organized into two primary semesters:
1. Autumn Semester (UG Autumn):
   - Duration: August to December.
   - Key Phases: Student registration, document verification, orientation, Quiz I evaluation window, Mid-Semester examinations, Quiz II window, last day of instruction, and centrally scheduled End-Semester examinations, followed by Winter vacation.
2. Spring Semester (UG Spring):
   - Duration: January to June.
   - Key Phases: Course registration in early January, commencement of classes, Spring Quiz I, Mid-Semester examinations, Technical Conclave, Spring Quiz II, End-Semester examinations, followed by Summer Term / Remedial courses / Convocation.
Downloadable calendar schedules on CET portal:
- UG Autumn 2024 (August 2024 – December 2024)
- UG Spring 2025 (January 2025 – June 2025)
- UG Autumn 2025 (August 2025 – December 2025)
- UG Spring 2026 (January 2026 – June 2026)
- UG Autumn 2026 (August 2026 – December 2026).
Link: https://cet.iitp.ac.in/index.php/academics/academic-calendar.

chunks.text: The academic year is split into Autumn Semester (August – December) and Spring Semester (January – June). Schedules include registration windows, Quiz I and II assessments, Mid-Semester examinations, and final centrally proctored End-Semester examinations. Detailed PDF calendars for 2024, 2025, and 2026 are published on the portal.

documents.page_title: IIT Patna Moodle LMS — Student Instructions & Public Access Guidelines
documents.summary: Public usage guidance for IIT Patna Moodle LMS, login authentication notice, and explicit privacy policy confirming the assistant never collects student credentials.
documents.content:
IIT Patna Moodle Learning Management System (LMS):
Portal URL: https://moodle.iitp.ac.in/.
Public Information & Instructions:
1. Purpose: Moodle is the official centralized e-learning portal for enrolled IIT Patna students and instructors. It hosts course syllabi, lecture slides, recorded lectures, weekly problem sets, and submission portals.
2. Authentication: Access to individual course pages and gradebooks requires active institute roll number credentials assigned by the IIT Patna Academic Section.
3. PUBLIC SAFETY & SECURITY NOTICE:
   - The CET AI Chatbot does NOT crawl, store, or access private, login-protected Moodle course contents or individual student submissions.
   - The CET AI Chatbot will NEVER request, store, or verify student passwords or credentials.
   - Students must log in directly via the official secure URL: https://moodle.iitp.ac.in/.
   - For password recovery or Moodle course enrollment issues, students should contact the CET Office (cet_office@iitp.ac.in) or the Computer Center helpdesk.

chunks.text: IIT Patna Moodle LMS is accessed at https://moodle.iitp.ac.in/. It is the official platform for enrolled students to access lecture notes, quizzes, and assignment submissions. Important: The CET AI chatbot does not crawl login-protected Moodle content and never asks for student login credentials or passwords.

documents.page_title: BS in Artificial Intelligence & Cyber Security (AICS) — Curriculum & Exit Credentials
documents.summary: 160-credit 4-year degree specifications: NEP 2020 exit awards (Certificate at 40 cr, Diploma at 80 cr, BSc at 120 cr, BS Honours at 160 cr), core modules, and plagiarism regulations.
documents.content:
BS in Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security (AICS) Curriculum Specification:
1. Degree Overview: 4-Year Bachelor of Science program, 160 credits total, 8 semesters.
2. NEP 2020 Multiple Exit Pathways:
   - Year 1 (40 Credits): Undergraduate Certificate in Computing Fundamentals.
   - Year 2 (80 Credits): Undergraduate Diploma in AI Foundations & Defensive Scripting.
   - Year 3 (120 Credits): Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in AI & Cyber Security.
   - Year 4 (160 Credits): Bachelor of Science (Honours / Research) in AI & Cyber Security.
3. Core Courses:
   - Semester I: CS101 Problem Solving & Python/C (4 credits), MA101 Linear Algebra (4 credits), CY101 Foundations of InfoSec (3 credits).
   - Semester II: CS201 Data Structures & Algorithms (4 credits), MA102 Probability & Statistics (4 credits), CS102 Computer Architecture (4 credits).
   - Semester III: AI301 Machine Learning Foundations (4 credits), CY201 Applied Cryptography (4 credits), CS203 Operating Systems (4 credits).
   - Semester IV: AI302 Deep Neural Networks (4 credits), CY202 Network Defense & Threat Hunting (4 credits), CS204 DBMS (4 credits).
   - Semester VII/VIII: AI401 Generative AI & LLMs (4 credits), CY401 Cloud Security (4 credits), CS499 8-Credit Capstone Project.
4. Laboratory Plagiarism Norm:
   - Any programming submission showing >15% lexical or syntactic overlap via tools like MOSS is awarded zero marks and escalated to the Institute Disciplinary Committee.

(Honours / Research).

documents.page_title: BS in Computer Science and Data Analytics (CSDA) — Curriculum Handbook
documents.summary: 160-credit 4-year curriculum focusing on software architecture, big data engineering (Hadoop/Spark), statistical modeling, and data pipelines.
documents.content:
BS in Computer Science and Data Analytics (CSDA) Curriculum Handbook:
1. Degree Overview: 4-Year Bachelor of Science program, 160 credits, 8 semesters.
2. Focus Areas: Dual competency in software engineering and statistical data analysis.
3. Core Courses:
   - MA201 Discrete Mathematical Structures (4 credits): Logic, graph theory, Eulerian paths, recurrence relations.
   - DS201 Applied Probability & Statistical Inference (4 credits): Central Limit Theorem, hypothesis testing.
   - MA202 Numerical Optimization (4 credits): Lagrange multipliers, gradient descent.
   - DS301 Distributed Computing & Big Data Engineering (4 credits): Apache Spark, HDFS, Kafka streaming.
   - CS205 Object Oriented Software Design (4 credits): SOLID principles, design patterns.
   - DS401 Statistical Machine Learning (4 credits): Regularization, ensemble methods.
   - DS402 Natural Language Processing & Text Mining (4 credits): Language models, BERT, text embeddings.
4. Capstone Analytics Project: Semester VIII involves high-throughput data pipelines and predictive modeling.

chunks.text: The BS in CSDA requires 160 credits over 4 years. Key subjects include MA201 Discrete Mathematical Structures, DS201 Applied Probability & Inference, DS301 Distributed Computing & Big Data (Spark/HDFS), and DS401 Statistical Machine Learning, concluding with a capstone analytics project in Semester VIII.
